title: paula score (.paula.toml)
description: Style, roles, progressions and song form for paula. The music checks (scale, register, clave, voices) stay in paula-lint.

name.description: Song title; the module name (first 20 characters).

bpm.description: Beats per minute the module plays at.

tempo.description: [low, high]; paula-lint warns when bpm is outside it.

swing.description: Stored for later; v0 does not render swing.

strict.description: Notes outside the key are errors instead of warnings.

progression.description: Named progressions: bars separated by |, one or two chords per bar, chord symbols (Am7 Fmaj7 G13b9) or degrees (ii7 V7 Imaj7).

channel.description: MOD channel 1-4; one role per channel.

sample.description: Sample number in the base module.

groove.description: 16 steps per bar: x hit, o ghost (quiet), . rest. Up to 4 rows separated by spaces, one per bar.

register.description: Pitched roles: lowest..highest note, like "C-1..C-2" (C-1 to B-3).

rule.description: Pitched roles: how notes come from the chord of each bar.

clave.description: Clave direction; paula-lint warns when roles differ.

max_density.description: Most hits (x and o) per bar before paula-lint warns.

duck.description: Sidechain-style ducking: the name of another role (usually the kick). On every hit of that role this role's volume drops to half and slides back up over the next two rows.

delay.description: Laid-back feel: every hit (x) plays this many ticks late (EDx note delay), below style.speed. At speed 6 and 90 BPM one tick is about 28 ms. Ghost notes are not delayed.

form.description: Sections in order, each a progression name and a bar count (multiple of 4): "intro 4, verse 8, chorus 8".
